import pytest
from flask import Blueprint


class TestBlueprintNameValidation:
    """I'm a scientist. I test hypotheses about empty names."""

    def test_empty_string_raises_valueerror(self):
        """An empty string is not a name. It's an absence of name."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="empty"):
            Blueprint("", __name__)

    def test_whitespace_only_raises_valueerror(self):
        """Spaces are just emptiness pretending to be something."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="empty"):
            Blueprint("   ", __name__)

    def test_tab_only_raises_valueerror(self):
        """Tabs are equally deceptive."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="empty"):
            Blueprint("\t", __name__)

    def test_newline_only_raises_valueerror(self):
        """Newlines? Please. I'm not fooled."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="empty"):
            Blueprint("\n", __name__)

    def test_mixed_whitespace_raises_valueerror(self):
        """Various whitespace combined is still nothing."""
        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="empty"):
            Blueprint("  \t\n  ", __name__)

    def test_valid_name_succeeds(self):
        """A proper name works. Obviously."""
        bp = Blueprint("auth", __name__)
        assert bp.name == "auth"

    def test_name_with_leading_trailing_whitespace_succeeds(self):
        """Names with actual content should work, even with padding.
        
        Though the implementation may choose to strip. That's...
        that's a design decision. Not my problem.
        """
        bp = Blueprint("  auth  ", __name__)
        # Either stripped or preserved, but it should work
        assert "auth" in bp.name

    def test_single_character_name_succeeds(self):
        """Even one character is more than nothing."""
        bp = Blueprint("x", __name__)
        assert bp.name == "x"

    def test_unicode_name_succeeds(self):
        """The fleet is diverse. Names should be too."""
        bp = Blueprint("über", __name__)
        assert bp.name == "über"
